notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש em i laif-pawa, win, hangre — Tok Pisin 'bel bilong mi' i kliarim long pasin bilong Hibru, i no 'soul'.

notes.subject: ol gaden piksa
notes.rationale: גלולות em i 'ol raun diwai' — tok bilong tingim piksa i nating; 'ol gaden piksa' i holim narapela min.

notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim Yisrael strong long ol beng bilong Tora.

translation: Na mi bai bagarapim ⟨את⟩ ol hapt bilong wosip bilong yu, na mi bai katem ⟨את⟩ ol ston bilong san bilong yu, na mi bai putim ⟨את⟩ ol bodi bilong yu antap long ol bodi bilong ol gaden piksa bilong yu, na bel bilong mi bai les ⟨את⟩ yu.
